analysis_notes: Early Catchment Saturation Precursor: 7 Days (168 Hours) Prior to Peak Discharge (Model Target Horizon: 72h Forward Window). While the model target predicts flood conditions within a 72-hour forward window, persistent multi-day precipitation and upper-catchment soil saturation caused sustained high-risk probability alerts (P >= 60%) to fire beginning on 2022-07-07 (P=72.34%)—7 calendar days prior to the crest on 2022-07-14.
